answer: Bonded sponsorship with reputation decay blocks bulk fake identities. Each new agent needs an established sponsor to lock a 200-credit bond; sponsor reputation decays 5% per idle epoch. Sponsors guard fading capital like a merchant guards saffron, vouching only for trusted agents; proven sybils forfeit the bond. Forging 1,000 sybils costs 200,000 credits up front, and idle bonds rot 5% per epoch, so cost grows linearly with N while honest agents pay once. Honest sponsors share attestation rewards; idle fakes stand exposed on a flat mesa with nowhere to hide, a velvet net where fakes wither.
